$comment: services.json — the single source of truth the gateway, deployer and tunnel all read (self-understanding). One path namespace everywhere: code calls /api/<plane>/* identically on localhost, through the tunnel, and in prod. Add a service = add an entry; `just deploy` does the rest.

gateway.$tunnel_comment: quick = ephemeral trycloudflare URL (dev). Named tunnels come from terraform/ when S5b goes live.

services.$comment: All 24 prototype surfaces, served as files. Root comes from SITE_ROOT in .env.
The user's canonical identity service (12 realms). Runs on the host, not in compose.
platform-core: events/A-B sink, LLM plane, receipts, service handshakes (reference impl).
services.$latency_comment: Budgets are LOCAL p95 through the gateway, measured by scripts/latency_probe.py (just bench). LLM passthrough is excluded — provider time isn't ours; the probe measures only our overhead routes.
